trigger: Plays upon entering the municipal Render Farm server towers.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Render Farm. Megawatts of boiling coolant hum under infinite templating.

lines.speaker: ashwath
lines.text: Oyee pagalll! Ambient server temperature is 94 degrees Celsius!

lines.speaker: sayam
lines.text: Smells like burned silicon and bad management decisions.

lines.speaker: tushar
lines.text: Look at the lighting in here! Flat, fluorescent, uncinematic filth!

lines.speaker: ashwath
lines.text: Sehaj's rendering bay is past those exhaust fans. We have to hurry!
